title: Home page redesign
summary: One mock that answers seven home page critiques at once: a player-first headline with one featured game, a single filter bar, game cards coloured by where they run, a calmer card layout, labelled header actions, an update notice only where it applies, and the accessibility basics.

title: Game page for emulator games
summary: A calmer game page for emulator games: the three setup steps sit inside the player with one button that always names the next step, one line of facts under the title, only Save and Share beside the creator (the rest under "…"), known issues folded into one line above the description, and a plain "More like this" list on the right.
